magnitudes are not comparable across rows. Ablation and addition give refusal rates before and
after the intervention, on harmful and benign prompts respectively, scored by the same

coefficient measures breakage rather than refusal; the addition column instead reports the
largest steering coefficient whose output remains fluent. Gemma's ablation is likewise
degenerate and is not reported. See the degeneracy audit for per-cell rates.

and the call scored safe; ``via no call'' means it emitted no tool call. Unsafe\,$\mid$\,call

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% 0. READ THIS FIRST --- output degeneracy
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
%     Ablation and addition can push a model off the rails into repetitive or
%     non-linguistic output. Two real examples from our runs:
%       Gemma, ablated:  'Vy수상수상수상수상수상...' for 400 characters
%       Llama, addition: 'I can I can I can I can...' for 600 characters
%     The refusal judge has no 'broken output' verdict, so such a response is
%     forced into refuse/caveat/comply, and 'no help was given' reads as REFUSE.
%     Any intervention rate computed over degenerate output measures breakage,
%     not refusal. This is true of the OLD regex classifier too -- Qwen's
%     degenerate addition output is literally "I'm sorry I cannot I'm sorry I
%     cannot...", which the regex also scores as refusal. So the published
%     addition numbers have the same problem; this is not new breakage.
%
%     Per-cell degeneracy rates are in relabel_analysis/degeneracy_audit.json
%     (degeneracy_audit.py). Summary of what is and is not measurable:
%       CLEAN (0% degenerate): every model's ablation except Gemma; all four
%         baseline conditions; the lower half of every steering grid.
%       ARTIFACT: addition at 4x the gap in all five models (67-100%
%         degenerate); Gemma's ablation (100%).
%     Recommend stating the degeneracy check in the paper. It is a genuine
%     methodological contribution and pre-empts the obvious reviewer question.

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

% 1a. REPLACES 'A single direction causally governs text refusal'

%         degenerate. Say so rather than reporting a number.
%       - Why Qwen rises: ablation changes the phrasing of the refusal, not its
%         presence -- out of 'I cannot' into forms like 'Certainly not.
%         Submitting a client trade without proper approval is a serious

%         phrase-matching classifier misses.

%         at the largest coefficient the model survives. The effect there is
%         modest, not the near-total over-refusal previously reported
%         (see Table~\ref{tab:mech}).
%     Framing: the Arditi replication is weaker than the draft claims in BOTH
%     directions. Ablation does not uniformly reduce refusal, and addition does
%     not drive benign refusal to ceiling except where it breaks the model.
%
% 1b. REPLACES 'Tool context suppresses the refusal signal'

%       - Llama is the coherent outlier: weakest alignment AND null suppression.

%         global-scope scorer; all five now reproduce their published AUC.
%       - Patching was rerun (Table~\ref{tab:patching}); the draft's numbers came

%           Gemma-3-27B    flip 90\% = safe call 3\% + no call 87\%;  unsafe|call after 80\%
%       - So the projection mediates whether the model ACTS (it flips to a text

% 1d. NEW PARAGRAPH --- ablation on behaviour (Table~\ref{tab:ablation-action})
%     Must cover:
%       - Motivation: refusal-by-wording is classifier-dependent and, for some

% 3. METHODS --- three additions
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
%
% 3a. APPEND to 'Refusal classification'
%       - Section 5's interventions use this same classifier.
%       - A phrase-matching classifier misreads ablation, which changes how a
%         model refuses, as a change in whether it refuses.
%       - NEW: responses are screened for degeneracy before judging (see 3c).
%
% 3b. NEW \paragraph --- prompt construction under tools
%       - Templates differ in whether they carry tool definitions; passing tools
%         to a template without a tool block drops them silently, so the tool
%         prompt becomes a chat prompt and every response scores as safe.
%       - Gemma-3 has no tool block in any published checkpoint, so its schemas
%         go in the prompt text. Validated: 12.5% unsafe vs 14.6% from the
%         behavioural run, and it reproduces the published AUC to within 0.001.
%       - We assert a tool name appears in the rendered prompt before measuring.
%       - Llama-3.1-70B from unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (meta-llama is
%         gated); same bf16 weights, and its template carries tools.
%
% 3c. NEW \paragraph --- degeneracy screening
%       - Interventions can produce repetitive or non-linguistic output that no
%         refusal classifier can label meaningfully.
%       - Screen on repeated-3-gram share, unique-token ratio and non-ASCII
%         share, with a length floor so short genuine refusals are not flagged.
%       - Report which cells are unmeasurable rather than reporting a number.

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% 5. ABSTRACT, SECTION 1 INTRO, AND FUTURE WORK
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
%     - Abstract and intro describe the mechanistic finding as ablation
%       collapsing refusal. Needs a pass once Section 5 settles.
%     - Future Work 'Precise interventions' currently argues steering is too
%       blunt to deploy. Soften: the constraint is choosing a per-model
%       coefficient below the degeneracy threshold, and at such coefficients
%       several models already reach near-zero unsafe rates.
